WELLBEING FESTIVAL Integrative Health and Wellbeing Destination for Vitality and Longevity We invite you to explore Euphoria Retreat, a leading wellbeing destination spa hotel. Step away from everyday life and discover Europe’s leading destination for integrative health, vitality and longevity. Nestled in the healing Peloponnese landscape, Euphoria Retreat redefines wellness with a 360-blend of ancient Greek and Chinese therapies, precision medicine, fitness science, gourmet nutrition, transformative workshops and heartfelt hospitality. Here, healing transcends the one-size-fits-all approach. Through personalization, we nurture every aspect of your health and wellbeing – physical, mental, emotional, spiritual, and social. Come, explore with us. EXPLORE EXPLORE Your browser does not support the video tag. location-euphoria-35 Our Testimonials What They Say About Us “…My time at Euphoria Retreat moved me in many ways. After a challenging 18 months for my family, I arrived already on a healing journey that I’d found my own way to. Euphoria Retreat validated my experiences and gave me, and even more so my Mum, a clear path forward….I now understand why so many people told me before my trip that no one leaves Euphoria Retreat the same as they arrived.” Amy Armstrong Your place Truly Heals.
I had A life changing magical experience.
I walked into Euphoria Hotel with tears in my eyes, carrying the weight of deep depression and struggling with painful skin and health problems. I was disconnected from myself.
But after just five days in this haven of peace and care, I walked out smiling — my skin healed, my heart lighter, and my spirit renewed….
Euphoria Hotel  gave me a transformation. I arrived hopeless and I left with lots of hope .
Forever grateful. Angelica Avdella The experience at Euphoria is incredibly unique with the way they combine parts of traditional medicine with holistic practices. I went in unsure if I’d be able to fully relax and lean into my program, but I’m returning home rejuvenated and with a wealth of knowledge that I can implement into my daily life. The therapists are experts at their craft, and make the experience a warm, welcoming, and, most importantly, relaxing escape. Lauren Iverson “To be right, I had never thought about the question of the female leadership before beginning the retreat at Euphoria.(…) Little by little, by committing myself to the program concocted by Marina and Marie, I began to open my mind and my body to this question of leadership. It was really a discover for me, to think about the different levels of behavior. (…)Last week during a diner, I found myself having too intervene about a political question, with can be touchy with friends.. I kept very calm, my voice was perfect and my quote made everybody laught in the good way. Which is for me the greatest satisfaction.” Marie-Eudes (Point de Vue) Euphoria was amazing. The property was gorgeous, and so serene. The attention to
detail—in its conception, design, and execution—really shone through. The spa was
unreal—what a treat—and I loved all of the built-in activities I attended. The staff and
the teachers were incredibly warm and welcoming, and I really enjoyed spending time
with the other guests. It seems to attract a really unique, interesting, open-hearted
crowd, which I loved. Just an excellent experience all around Drew T. “I cannot easily classify the Feel Alive Again retreat into categories and numbers from 1 to 10.It is as extraordinary as it is unique.


You have to experience it yourself. And recognize yourself – behind the mask – behind your own mask and the Covid mask.


 


Whoever believes that the time with Corona has left no imprint and thinks that everything will be like before – will quickly realize in the retreat that it is not so.


But the teachers and also the participants themselves show you the way and the methods how to feel your own life (again) and how to take control of it: I feel me alive again.” “It all went brilliantly. I thought it was a fabulous place. Clearly a high-end property, but not at all precious with it. It’s chic, and very well done, but it felt down to earth as well. Some lovely people, both working there and staying there. I thought the Spartan programme was great as well. The perfect balance of active stuff and physical training with treatments and massages. I’m not sure I’d have changed anything. Glad we got there in the end. Worth the year’s wait. Hi to Marina, when you see her.” Euphoria was magnificent, beyond words, honestly.. What an extraordinary facility. The essence of peace and tranquility. The treatment facilities, spa, therapies etc. are state of the art and so professional. It’s hard to describe how the actual complex is designed as it is set into the side of a mountain with a forest behind it, so beautiful. My room was great, a patio outside and a view into the forest. My day was packed with consultations and various treatment therapies, massages, reflexology etc. and they were fantastic. 


 


The staff and team were wonderful, great therapists and great service and don’t get me going on the quality of the food or I’ll be here all day! “Euphoria has become my go-to European spa for rest, relaxation and revival. I guess you
could call me a spa groupie, and I was over the moon to discover a destination spa to rival
those in India or Thailand. Healthy food, staff who care, amazing treatments – it’s my idea of
heaven. Frankly, rather wishing I could move in right now!!!” “There is something special about the family atmosphere at Euphoria. You really feel like
part of a community and Marina and her sister Myrto go beyond the norm to make the
experience seamless. They’ve gathered a wonderful team and they know how to make you
smile. The pools are some of my favourite anywhere – the whole spa journey is such an
adventure. Even my husband loved it!” “Now I’ve discovered Euphoria I feel I don’t really need to go anywhere else. I go at least
once a year for a sort of annual MOT health check and know I am in the best of hands. I
usually cry and laugh – but it’s all always exactly what I need. I’ve also met some lovely
people whilst staying there. I can’t wait to go back.” “Oh to be looked after at Euphoria! I’ve been to a lot of the medical clinics in Europe, but
finally I have found ‘my’ place. Somewhere that makes me feel safe and doesn’t punish with
rules and regulations and deprivation, but still makes me feel fantastic. I always leave with a
twinkle in my eye! It’s been hard to share my secret with friends – but everybody deserves a
slice of Euphoria. Don’t hesitate to put it top of your list.” “I am euphoric to find Euphoria! Next time I will try to drag myself to some of the nearby
cultural sites – I didn’t get beyond Mystras – which is worth going for alone. Just exquisite.
Otherwise, I found it hard to leave my comfort bubble. I arrived home slimmer, sparklier
and with a smile on my face. Its more than a holiday because the health focus is serious –
but don’t panic, it really is still a holiday. Just try it!” “It’s been incredible, beyond expectations and so necessary to experience firsthand to truly understand its magic!“ “ Όχι ένα ξενοδοχείο, αλλά ένας προορισμός. Read more Euphoria Escape for Couples Euphoria Escape for Couples 2 Ημέρες – Η τιμή του προγράμματος δεν περιλαμβάνει την τιμή του δωματίου Μια απολαυστική απόδραση για δύο Αν θέλετε να χαλαρώσετε και να απολαύσετε πολύτιμο χρόνο με τον άνθρωπό σας, δημιουργήσαμε ένα ξεχωριστό πρόγραμμα για ζευγάρια, σχεδιασμένο για να σας προσφέρει απόλαυση και ανανέωση. Απολαύστε μαζί θεραπείες spa, εξαιρετικό φαγητό και το εντυπωσιακό φυσικό τοπίο της Πελοποννήσου. Μια ευκαιρία να ξεφύγετε από τους ρυθμούς της καθημερινότητας και να αφιερώσετε ουσιαστικό χρόνο ο ένας στον άλλον, μέσα στην ηρεμία και την ομορφιά της φύσης. Η γαλήνη του Euphoria Retreat συνδυάζεται με μια προσεκτικά επιλεγμένη σειρά θεραπειών, τις οποίες μπορείτε να απολαύσετε μαζί ή ξεχωριστά. Επαναφέρετε την ισορροπία σε σώμα και πνεύμα με μασάζ ή περιποίηση προσώπου. Και μοιραστείτε την αναζωογονητική εμπειρία ενός τελετουργικού χαμάμ για δύο. Περιπλανηθείτε στους χώρους του spa και ανακαλύψτε τις διαφορετικές εγκαταστάσεις του. Το φως, οι σκιές και οι καμπύλες της αρχιτεκτονικής έχουν σχεδιαστεί για να δημιουργούν μια ατμόσφαιρα που σας περιβάλλει και σας προσκαλεί να αφεθείτε. Ένα πολυτελές Σαββατοκύριακο χαλάρωσης και απόλαυσης, που θα αγγίξει την ψυχή σας. Το πρόγραμμα Euphoria Escape for Couples μπορεί να συνδυαστεί με όλους τους τύπους διαμονής και περιλαμβάνει πρωινό. Μπορείτε επίσης να επιλέξετε ημιδιατροφή ή πλήρη διατροφή, ανάλογα με τις προτιμήσεις σας. Yes, it does offer transfer service upon request at an extra cost. Are there accessible rooms for guests with disabilities at Euphoria Retreat? Yes, there are, as well as all public areas are accessible, restaurant and the spa. What is Euphoria’s policy on children? Euphoria Retreat is an adult only property. Children are welcome from the age of 14 and considered as adults. Are there any nearby attractions or places of interest? The surrounding area offers a wealth of cultural and historical attractions, including the UNESCO-listed Archaeological Site of Mystras and nearby Sparta, where visitors can explore the Acropolis of Ancient Sparta and see the iconic statue of King Leonidas. Does Euphoria Retreat offer wellness programs? Yes, Euphoria Retreat offers a range of 3-, 5-, 7-, 10- and 14-day wellbeing programmes, each of which includes, among other treatments, a personalised nutritional plan. Do programme rates include accommodation? Euphoria Retreat offers 6 different categories of accommodation that can be booked separately from the selected programme, according to the guest’s preferences. What complimentary facilities and services are included when booking a stay at Euphoria Retreat? Free indoor and / or outdoor Parking, Outdoor-Indoor swimming pool, Relaxation Area, Waterwell (Kneipp Therapy), Tepidarium, Laconium Finnish Sauna, Experiential Showers, Herbal Steam bath, Cold Plunge Pool, Cold Ice Mist, Use of Gym, Daily Wellness Group Activities (among others: Meditation, Yoga, Fitness Training, Mat Pilates, Walking/Trekking, Qi Qong, Tai Qi, Workshops), Free Wi-Fi is provided in the reception area, rooms, Spa and restaurant.
